{{Top|leg}}
'''Constructors''' were a caste sub-group of [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] society. Constructors were organized into guilds based on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] within the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]].
